display.purpose: Hero h1 and section h2. The only place Syne appears at scale.

body.purpose: Default UI text in IBM Plex Mono — tables, descriptions, button labels, navigation. The system's resting voice.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono with 0.08em tracking — timestamps, run states, section eyebrows, schedule strings.

shadows.name: surface-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default panel surface shadow — establishes a card sitting on the page.

shadows.name: window-depth
shadows.purpose: Dashboard preview window and large content shells. Includes a hairline highlight at the top.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft teal glow under the primary action card or button. Signals focus, not depth.

shadows.name: status-pulse
shadows.purpose: Small halo on active status dots. Signals liveness — current state, not historical.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for transitions and entrance animations.

motion.name: ease-out-back
motion.purpose: Rare — used only when a small overshoot is the right feedback signal.

motion.name: pulse-running
motion.purpose: Status dot pulse for active / running state only. Suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary call-to-action. Sharp 0px corners, teal fill on near-black text. Used at most once per primary region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #06d6a0; color: #050810; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00f5d4; box-shadow: 0 0 80px -40px rgba(6,214,160,0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #06d6a0, 0 0 0 3px rgba(6,214,160,0.25); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary action. Transparent fill, subtle border, primary text. Used for the bulk of dashboard actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(6,214,160,0.4); background: rgba(6,214,160,0.05); color: #06d6a0; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #06d6a0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(6,214,160,0.3); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Destructive confirms. Red text on a 10%-alpha red surface — never a full red fill until the irreversible final step.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); color: #ef4444; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.2); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.4); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(239,68,68,0.3); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Sharp 0px corners matching buttons. Transparent on parent surface; border shifts on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #06d6a0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(6,214,160,0.3); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(239,68,68,0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: 20px soft corners on tinted-neutral surface. Counterweight to the sharp interactive controls.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; background: #151c2c; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid rgba(31,41,55,0.5); border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 16px 44px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(6,214,160,0.3); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Syne', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #94a3b8; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Status Badge — Success
components.description: Status reads from status colors at 10%-alpha background with full-saturation text. Status color carries semantic meaning only.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; background: rgba(34,197,94,0.1); color: #22c55e; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22c55e; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0.5); }

components.name: Type Badge — MCP
components.description: Violet-tinted pill marking MCP / AI / agent affordances. Fully rounded to differentiate from the status family.
components.css: .ds-badge-mcp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15); color: #8b5cf6; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: Tiny but load-bearing. Halo signals liveness — current state, not historical.
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-status-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-running { background: #06d6a0; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(6,214,160,0.5); animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(6,214,160,0.5); } 50% { opacity: 0.6; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(6,214,160,0.8); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-running { animation: none; } } .ds-status-label { color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: The signature ornament — a 24px teal rule + uppercase mono eyebrow. Used to mark section breaks across product and marketing.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #06d6a0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-section-label::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 24px; height: 1px; background: #06d6a0; }

components.name: Table Row
components.description: Compact, scannable, subtle hover. Mono throughout. Tables are for scanning, not for wrapped prose.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-table thead th { padding: 8px; text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(31,41,55,0.6); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody td { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(31,41,55,0.4); white-space: nowrap; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(31,41,55,0.5); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { color: #f8fafc; } .ds-table-status { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-table-status-ok { background: #22c55e; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0.5); }

narrative.overview: Cronlet looks like the second monitor of a senior operator at 2am — dim, dense, deliberate. The screen is dark not for fashion but because it is read in a dim room, after an alert, by someone who needs to know within ten seconds whether their organization is healthy. Information has weight: tables are compact, labels are monospace, status is unambiguous. There is no decoration competing with state. The visual language sits in the lineage of BetterStack, Linear, and Vercel — dev-tool dark, dense but calm, structured by typography and alignment rather than ornament. Sharp 0px corners on interactive controls give the system its operator-grade edge; softer 20px corners on cards provide breathing rhythm so the density does not feel hostile.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, tinted-neutral palette anchored on near-black #050810
Mono-as-body (IBM Plex Mono) with geometric sans (Syne) for display only
Sharp 0px corners for interactive controls, soft 20px for surfaces
One accent (teal #06d6a0) carrying state and primary action; violet reserved for AI/MCP affordances
Compact density: 32px button height, 8px gutters, no decorative whitespace
Motion as feedback only: state changes, no choreography

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary teal #06d6a0 appears on no more than 10% of any given screen. Its rarity is what makes it read as signal rather than decoration.

rules.name: The Status-Color Lockdown
rules.body: Emerald, amber, and red are reserved for run state. They never appear as decorative accents, never carry brand voice, never appear in copy or links.

rules.name: The Violet-Means-Agent Rule
rules.body: Violet #8b5cf6 only appears when the surface is talking about AI, MCP, or agent affordances. Used decoratively, it becomes the AI-startup-neon anti-reference; used semantically, it teaches the user a real signal.

rules.name: The Mono-First Rule
rules.body: Body text is monospace. This is the system's resting voice. Mono-as-body is what makes Cronlet read as operator-grade rather than consumer-SaaS.

rules.name: The Syne-Earns-Its-Place Rule
rules.body: Syne is reserved for display and titles only. Never for body, table headers, button labels, or labels.

rules.name: The All-Caps Meta Rule
rules.body: All-caps + 0.08em tracking + mono is the signal for meta — timestamps, run states, section eyebrows, schedule strings. Anywhere else, it reads as shouty.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth comes from tinted-neutral layering, not shadows. Shadows are responses — to focus, to state, to 'this is a window, not a card.'

rules.name: The No-Decorative-Glow Rule
rules.body: Glows that do not encode state are decoration. A glow on a button is allowed because it tells the user this is the primary action. A glow under a heading is decoration.

dos: Do keep the primary teal #06d6a0 to ≤10% of any given screen.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for all body, table, navigation, and label copy.
Do keep interactive controls (buttons, inputs, tabs) on sharp 0px corners, and surfaces (cards, panels) on 20px corners.
Do convey state with both color and a glyph or text label — never color alone.
Do stack tinted neutrals to convey depth: bg-deep → bg-elevated → bg-card → bg-hover.
Do reserve violet #8b5cf6 for AI / MCP / agent affordances.
Do make every primary flow keyboard-reachable, with visible focus rings on dark surfaces.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — pulses, fades, and entrance animations collapse to instant.
donts: Don't use the Tailwind/shadcn purple-gradient SaaS template.
Don't apply AI-startup neon-on-black aesthetics — no glow text, no animated gradients, no decorative neon.
Don't use glassmorphism (backdrop-filter + translucent fill) as a decorative pattern.
Don't build a gradient-hero-with-giant-number landing template.
Don't drown the dashboard in unprioritized panels — Datadog/Grafana sprawl is the anti-reference.
Don't hide state behind multi-step wizards.
Don't mix proportional sans into body copy.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent.
Don't use gradient text — background-clip:text gradients are decorative, never meaningful.
Don't mix status colors and action colors.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
